name: Bundle of Akiris Reeds
summary: A Bundle of Akiris Reeds is a shipment carried to Privateer Groy in Theramore. He checks it for a client who wants more.

sections.title: A Fresh Shipment
sections.body: Privateer Groy receives the reeds in Theramore after Bloads sends another shipment his way. Groy looks the bundle over, pleased that it will satisfy his client. Then he pays the courier and sends them off his docks.

faq.answer: Privateer Groy receives the Bundle of Akiris Reeds in Theramore for a client who wants more.

faq.q: Where do I take the bundle?
faq.answer: Bring the Bundle of Akiris Reeds to Privateer Groy in Theramore.
Bloads asks you to carry the shipment to Privateer Groy in Theramore.

faq.q: What does Groy do with it?
faq.answer: Groy inspects the reeds and says another bundle will please his client.
